summary: Learn Tableau worksheets, filters, KPI calculations, and dashboard checks through practical exercises. Explore the five-day training outline.
lede: Tableau data visualization helps reporting analysts, business intelligence practitioners, and operational team leads compare measures and explore structured data. You’ll practise connecting and checking data, selecting charts, creating KPI calculations, configuring filters and parameters, and assembling interactive dashboards. The course also covers dashboard usability, validating results against source data, and presenting evidence-based takeaways for decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who prepare, review, or explain dashboards and recurring performance reports using operational data. It is designed for people who need a practical starting workflow in Tableau, not prior programming experience.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop with Tableau Public Desktop installed and access to a Tableau Public account. Download Tableau's Sample - Superstore practice dataset before training. Use only non-sensitive data when publishing to Tableau Public. No coding or prior Tableau experience is required.
